text: In Haiti, newly arrived Madeleine is to marry her fiancé Neil, but the plantation owner Charles Beaumont, obsessed with her, [strikes a secret deal|wrong|bargains with dark powers] with the voodoo master Legendre in a sugarcane mill worked by the dead. A potion hidden in her wedding flowers makes her seem to die. From her empty tomb she is carried to a cliffside castle as one of [the soulless zombies who serve him|threat|the dead that rise], while Charles feels [the same trance creeping into him|rules|it gets inside you].
